segments.text: Ok so this is the Pausing the Agent for Input page for Google Antigravity with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, the page talks about the backend agent pausing for input, but no Antigravity backend for it is shown or linked.
So this default agent never interrupts.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, an agent that actually pauses, wasn't on the page, so I added it myself.
Moving on to the demo. Only with my own agent does the panel show up, following the page nothing pauses at all.
So basically, without a backend that pauses, inject interrupt never fires.
And the page never gives you one.
So kindly look into it, thanks.
